infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fogline uses your location while the app is open to reveal the map where you walk.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow background location so Fogline keeps revealing your map as you walk, even when the app is closed. Fogline never stores your route — only the coarse zones you have explored.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Fogline reads your step counter to make sure only walking reveals the map — never driving, cycling or transit.
